home.subtitle: Composition and trend across bank accounts, properties, and vehicles.
home.categoryStackDescription: Percentage of total value by category, month-by-month ({{currency}}).
home.categoryPieDescription: Share of current value by category ({{currency}}).

bankAccount.listSubtitle: Track monthly balances across your household's bank accounts.
bankAccount.emptyBody: Create your first bank account to start tracking month-end balances.
bankAccount.createDescription: Track a bank account in your household. You'll record monthly balance snapshots from your bank statements afterwards.
bankAccount.editDescription: Update the account's display name, bank details, description, or ownership. Currency can't be changed. To use a different one, create a new account.
bankAccount.snapshotsDescription: Monthly balance readings from your bank statements.
bankAccount.snapshotsEmpty: No snapshots yet. A snapshot is the value on your statement at month-end. Record one each month.

tour.overviewBody: Track this account's balance over time — record it each month to keep your net worth current.
tour.actionsBody: Use “Edit” to change its details, “Close…” to mark it ended — it then stops counting toward your net worth — or “Delete” to remove it entirely.
tour.detailsBody: Bank, account type, and owner were set when you added the account. Use “Edit” to change them.
tour.chartBody: Each point is a month's recorded balance, so you can see the trend at a glance.
tour.snapshotsBody: Each row is one month's balance. Tap “Record snapshot” to add this month's, or “Import” to add several at once.

property.listSubtitle: Track monthly values across the household's properties.
property.emptyBody: Create your first property to start tracking month-end values.
property.createDescription: Track a property in your household. You'll record monthly value snapshots manually; an amortisation rate helper UI will arrive later.
property.editDescription: Update the property's details or ownership. Currency can't be changed. To use a different one, create a new property.
property.snapshotsEmpty: No snapshots yet. A snapshot is the value on your statement at month-end. Record one each month.

tour.overviewBody: Track this property's value over time — update it as the market moves.
tour.actionsBody: Use “Edit” to change its details, “Close…” to mark it ended — it then stops counting toward your net worth — or “Delete” to remove it entirely.
tour.detailsBody: Type, address, and acquisition details were set when you added it. The appreciation rate is a helper for estimating new values. Use “Edit” to change them.
tour.chartBody: Each point is a month's recorded value, showing how the property has appreciated.
tour.snapshotsBody: Each row is one month's value. Tap “Record snapshot” to add the current value — the appreciation-rate helper can suggest one — or “Import” for several months.

vehicle.listSubtitle: Track monthly values across the household's vehicles.
vehicle.emptyBody: Create your first vehicle to start tracking month-end values.
vehicle.createDescription: Track a vehicle in your household. You'll record monthly value snapshots manually; a depreciation rate helper UI will arrive later.
vehicle.editDescription: Update the vehicle's details or ownership. Currency can't be changed. To use a different one, create a new vehicle.
vehicle.snapshotsEmpty: No snapshots yet. A snapshot is the value on your statement at month-end. Record one each month.

tour.overviewBody: Track this vehicle's value over time — it usually declines as it ages.
tour.actionsBody: Use “Edit” to change its details, “Close…” to mark it ended — it then stops counting toward your net worth — or “Delete” to remove it entirely.
tour.detailsBody: Type and acquisition details were set when you added it. The depreciation rate is a helper for estimating new values. Use “Edit” to change them.
tour.chartBody: Each point is a month's recorded value, showing how the vehicle has depreciated.
tour.snapshotsBody: Each row is one month's value. Tap “Record snapshot” to add the current value — the depreciation-rate helper can suggest one — or “Import” for several months.
